carry_forward_constraints: S39 closes Level 3 / CP-N3-C / CF-3 and must not treat S38 concurrency, observability or resilience gates as passed. Only repaired, machine-valid S38 artifacts may enter the level regression.

S39 must inherit the S37 BenchmarkManifest discipline: fixture/data hash, code/config versions, stage boundary, environment fingerprint, samples and artifact-specific equivalence oracle remain fixed across monitoring or operational comparisons.
Concurrency/retry ordering must not alter candidate IDs, rankings, tie policy, abstention or human-review destination. Compare outputs by stable case IDs rather than completion order.

Any checkpoint/idempotency claim inherited from S38 must survive induced crashes before/after the external effect and a real process/store reopen. In-memory dict/set state, status='done' before effect and check-then-add are explicitly invalid evidence.

Idempotency token and mutating operation must be atomic or explicitly reconciliable. Preserve the original operation/workflow version across late retries so a deployment does not manufacture a new identity for old intent.
Retry only allowlisted transient failures. Unknown/permanent/validation/auth/business failures fail closed to DLQ/handoff. Define max retries vs attempts, cap/deadline and jitter policy.

A DLQ must be a durable artifact with message hash/content reference, failure cause, attempts/timestamps, idempotency identity and code/config version; replay must be selected and version-linked, never blind bulk reinjection.
A runbook must exist as a versioned artifact and be exercised in a synthetic drill; runbook=True is not evidence.
Observability evidence must separate structured logs, metrics and spans. Propagate trace_id/span_id and optionally correlation_id; pii_raw=False is not proof of privacy.
Use allowlisted/minimized log schemas and reserved synthetic domains such as example.com/.test. Do not reintroduce example.pe.

Compute SLI/SLO from a defined window and valid denominator. Reject negative/nonfinite latency/error rates. Error-budget policy depends on budget consumption/burn over the compliance window, not one instantaneous threshold comparison.
Queue maxsize is an item-count/backpressure bound, not a byte/RSS memory cap. If S39 claims memory safety, measure payload/working-set/RSS under load.
Rate limiting must include a real time window/refill and concurrency-safe state when shared; a static decrementing counter is only a quota and cannot prove requests-per-window.

Do not use a categorical CPU=>processes rule. Record CPython build/runtime and library behavior; many NumPy kernels release the GIL and free-threaded CPython exists. Benchmark plausible executors on the actual workload.
ProcessPool serialization/IPC evidence must use the actual picklable payload/transport or an explicitly labeled approximation; json.dumps byte length alone is not ProcessPool IPC cost.
S39 operational monitoring must jointly examine throughput, latency distribution, timeout/error rate, queue depth/backpressure and resource saturation; higher throughput alone is not a win.

Carry systematic pytest from S27: S39 level regression must include S38 invalid-bound metrics, queue overflow, limiter window, timeout cancellation, PII schema, SLI domain, retry classification, crash/reopen, atomic duplicate race and controlled replay regressions.
The S38 Theory playground is on-topic but currently contradicts safe queue handling (full()+put) and only constructs an idempotency key; do not cite it as operational evidence until repaired.
Inherited S26-S38 debt remains active. CP-N3-C/CF-3 cannot pass while upstream data/ER/features/evaluation/performance/resilience evidence is contaminated, leaked, non-reconstructible or non-durable.
